name: compas
description: Compás — a tango DJ player. Live player + tanda builder, built on the vite-electron-builder template.
author: pkakelas

scripts.compile: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs
scripts.compile:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --mac
scripts.compile:win: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --win
scripts.compile:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --dir
scripts.compile:publish: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --publish always
